chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muawiya ibn Maysara, from al-Hakam ibn Uteyba, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, in Paradise is a river in which Jibraeel (peace be upon him) dives every morning. Then he comes out of it and shakes, so Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, creates an angel from every drop that falls from him.
ai.seo_question: What happens in the river of Paradise where Jibraeel immerses himself?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith highlights the continuous creation of angels (khalq al-mala'ika) through the Archangel Jibraeel's morning immersion in a specific river of Paradise, reflecting the Shia belief in the dynamic nature of the celestial realm. It underscores the divine power to generate infinite beings from a single source, reinforcing the concept of Allah's ongoing creative act beyond the initial creation of the universe.
